parameters.query: SELECT u.email, COALESCE(u."firstName", '') AS first_name, pu.n8n_user_id::text AS user_id, json_agg(json_build_object('id', rc.id, 'headline', rc.headline, 'url', rc.article_url, 'why', rc.alignment_why, 'verdict', rc.verdict, 'source', COALESCE(rs.name, ''), 'created_at', rc.created_at) ORDER BY rc.created_at DESC) AS concepts FROM portal_user pu JOIN "user" u ON u.id = pu.n8n_user_id JOIN radar_concepts rc ON rc.user_id = pu.n8n_user_id LEFT JOIN radar_sources rs ON rs.id = rc.source_id WHERE u.email = 'bensteenbergen@gmail.com' AND rc.status IN ('active', 'saved') AND rc.created_at > now() - interval '7 days' GROUP BY u.email, u."firstName", pu.n8n_user_id
